references.text: The context where God commands the Israelites to remove their jewelry as a sign of humility and repentance after the sin with the golden calf.
The Israelites originally gave their gold jewelry to Aaron to make the golden calf. Now they take off their jewelry as a sign of repentance.
Moses' reaction to the golden calf sin at Mount Horeb, which led to the people's humility and removal of jewelry.
Jacob commanded his household to remove foreign gods and cleanse themselves, similar to laying aside jewelry as a sign of spiritual cleansing.
Isaiah warns against pride linked to jewelry and adornment, and prophesies that the Lord will take them away as judgment.
God gave Israel jewelry as a sign of His love, but they misused the gifts for idol worship.
